---
title: Glossary
---

This glossary will grow as the technical draft is verified and migrated.

| Term | Meaning |
|---|---|
| NADABAS | National Accounts Database System. |
| Add-in | The Excel artifact that hosts the NADABAS VBA project. |
| Exported VBA | Text-based `.bas`, `.cls`, `.frm`, and related `.frx` files stored under `vba/`. |
| Source of truth | The version-controlled representation from which a review or build is performed. For VBA, this is the exported source below `vba/`. |
| Review build | A non-production add-in created from reviewed source for functional verification. |
| Security approval | A narrow, version-controlled exception for one expected scanner finding; it is not a general suppression. |
| ADR | Architecture Decision Record. |
| Architecture claim | A reviewable statement with a stable identifier, evidence status, and source or test reference. |
| Base database | The default database role used for workbook data and NADABAS system metadata. |
| BCP 47 | The standard syntax used to identify a human language, and optionally script or region, in digital content. |
| Exchange database | A database role selected temporarily by NADABAS import and export workflows. |
| Informative translation | A translation supplied for understanding that is not the authoritative basis for technical change decisions. |
| Normative working version | The version against which technical changes and review dispositions are recorded. It does not imply legal normativity. |
| Review baseline | The exact source commit, documentation version, deployment scope, and evidence set assessed by reviewers. |
| Satellite database | An optional database role linked through configuration to a base database. |
| Source-verified | Directly supported by exported source at the stated commit; runtime behaviour may still require testing. |
| Trust boundary | A point where data or control crosses between components with different security or operational assumptions. |
| DBLinks | A workbook named range whose rows define database load and save operations. |
| ExchLinks | A workbook named range used by exchange-database import and export operations. |
| Key family | A user-defined set of dimensions represented by a database table with value and provenance columns. |
| Dirty state | NADABAS session state indicating data may need a database save; separate from Excel's file-saved state. |
| Base path | The configured root used to resolve portable paths beginning with `!`. |
| Legacy draft | A statement inherited from the retained Word draft that is not established by the current source baseline. |
